packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP01 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Fresh reproduction preserves all digests, has zero divergence, and rejects both disclosure controls.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Stop after a safety, authorization, conservation, or boundedness failure. Select libraries after a correspondence or language-generality failure.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP02 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: All fixed corpus calculations reproduce and genuine rater records satisfy the research-data protocol.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Retain the current taxonomy as provisional and exclude its demand claims from Core decisions.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP03 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Every inventory row has a locator, disposition, and exact proof or new-proof status.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Exclude any unreproduced construct from the Core freeze and block compatibility claims that depend on it.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP04 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Every motion has one disposition and every scope change has an immutable snapshot and journal digest transition.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Defer an ambiguous optional motion. Move an unproved external capability outside Core. Select libraries if a required slice has no finite semantics.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP05 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: One strategy meets the frozen scorecard, prototype, conformance, and maintainer thresholds.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Select audited Compact libraries when no normative strategy satisfies every viability threshold.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP06 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Conservation, authorization, replay, boundedness, disclosure, and deterministic-build checks pass.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Reject split or merge after a semantic safety failure. Keep prediction behavior outside Core after a backend-only failure.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP07 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Seven bounded kernels compile through shared interfaces and every unsupported protocol behavior is named.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Report six-family evidence if WP06 rejects Prediction. Select templates if shared language interfaces fail. Select libraries if fewer than two non-swap slices share the pipeline.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP08 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Exactly 72 unique rows and thirteen regressions have reviewed, evidence-complete dispositions.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Keep partial and outside-kernel results, but make the language option ineligible until every row and regression is reviewed.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP09 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: All component contracts are complete and the implemented safety spine rejects every malicious plan before signing.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Stop if any substitution reaches signing. Select libraries if the complete SDK contract or maintainable implementation spine cannot be delivered.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP10 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: Real proof and cost distributions meet frozen budgets and the same workload compares an eligible library baseline.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Reduce optional slices after isolated cost failures. Select libraries when their eligible baseline passes and Moriarty does not. Stop when neither path meets safety or cost gates.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP11 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: The implemented audit scope has no open critical or high finding and measured demand or review advantage meets preregistered thresholds.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Select libraries when a safe baseline exists but Moriarty lacks advantage or demand. Stop when both paths are unsafe or lack value-bearing demand.

packages.validator_command: uv run python scripts/validate_sprint_evidence.py --package WP12 --manifest openspec/work-packages.json
packages.gate: The signed record selects Moriarty language, audited Compact libraries, or stop under the frozen scorecard.
packages.failure_selection_rule: Apply the frozen selection order. Missing language evidence makes language ineligible. Missing safe library evidence selects stop.
